# datascan

The goal of datascan is to provide a set of functions to perform data
quality checks and data exploration in R. It includes functions for
checking missing values, identifying nested columns, and other common
data quality issues.

## Installation

You can install the development version of datascan from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("emitanaka/datascan")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

``` r

library(datascan)
head(CO2)
#>   Plant   Type  Treatment conc uptake
#> 1   Qn1 Quebec nonchilled   95   16.0
#> 2   Qn1 Quebec nonchilled  175   30.4
#> 3   Qn1 Quebec nonchilled  250   34.8
#> 4   Qn1 Quebec nonchilled  350   37.2
#> 5   Qn1 Quebec nonchilled  500   35.3
#> 6   Qn1 Quebec nonchilled  675   39.2
cols_identify_all(CO2)
#> → No columns with all unique values.
#> → No bijective columns.
#> → No constant columns.
#> → No identified columns with missing proportion.
#> 
#> ── Checking if all values are unique in a column ───────────────────────────────
#> [1] NA
#> 
#> ── Checking if any two columns are bijective ───────────────────────────────────
#> list()
#> 
#> ── Checking if any column is all constant ──────────────────────────────────────
#> [1] NA
#> 
#> ── Checking if columns with preset cut-off in missing values ───────────────────
#> [1] NA
cols_nested(CO2)
#> [[1]]
#> [1] "Plant" "Type" 
#> 
#> [[2]]
#> [1] "Plant"     "Treatment"
concurrence_matrix(CO2, Plant, Type)
#> • Diagonal shows the total number of levels for Plant at the corresponding
#>   level for Type
#> • Off-diagonal shows the number of common levels for Plant between the two
#>   levels for Type
#>              
#>               Quebec Mississippi
#>   Quebec           6           0
#>   Mississippi      0           6
#>   
#> ℹ Concurrence matrix: 2 × 2 Type.
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`add_row_id()`](http://emitanaka.org/datascan/reference/add_row_id.md)
  : Add a row ID column to a data frame
- [`as_numerical()`](http://emitanaka.org/datascan/reference/as_numerical.md)
  : Coerce to numerical and identify non-numerical entries
- [`cols_all_unique()`](http://emitanaka.org/datascan/reference/cols_all_unique.md)
  : Identify columns with all unique values
- [`cols_bijective()`](http://emitanaka.org/datascan/reference/cols_bijective.md)
  : Identify bijective (one-to-one correspondence) columns
- [`cols_constant()`](http://emitanaka.org/datascan/reference/cols_constant.md)
  [`cols_unary()`](http://emitanaka.org/datascan/reference/cols_constant.md)
  : Identify constant columns
- [`cols_identify_all()`](http://emitanaka.org/datascan/reference/cols_identify_all.md)
  : Identify all columns with potential issues
- [`cols_missing()`](http://emitanaka.org/datascan/reference/cols_missing.md)
  : Identify columns that have certain proportion of missing values
- [`cols_binary()`](http://emitanaka.org/datascan/reference/cols_multinary.md)
  [`cols_ternary()`](http://emitanaka.org/datascan/reference/cols_multinary.md)
  [`cols_multinary()`](http://emitanaka.org/datascan/reference/cols_multinary.md)
  : Identify columns with a specific number of unique values
- [`cols_nested()`](http://emitanaka.org/datascan/reference/cols_nested.md)
  : Nestedness checks
- [`concurrence_matrix()`](http://emitanaka.org/datascan/reference/concurrence_matrix.md)
  [`concurrence_table()`](http://emitanaka.org/datascan/reference/concurrence_matrix.md)
  : Get the concurrence matrix or table
- [`is_complete()`](http://emitanaka.org/datascan/reference/is_complete.md)
  : Is variable complete within another variable?
- [`is_nested()`](http://emitanaka.org/datascan/reference/is_nested.md)
  : Is variable nested within another variable?
- [`is_numerical()`](http://emitanaka.org/datascan/reference/is_numerical.md)
  : Is the variable numerical?
- [`is_observational_unit()`](http://emitanaka.org/datascan/reference/is_observational_unit.md)
  [`is_obs_unit()`](http://emitanaka.org/datascan/reference/is_observational_unit.md)
  : Is it the observational unit?
- [`rows_missing()`](http://emitanaka.org/datascan/reference/rows_missing.md)
  : Identify rows that have certain proportion of missing values
- [`watch_tits`](http://emitanaka.org/datascan/reference/watch_tits.md)
  : Coordination of care by breeders and helpers in the cooperatively
  breeding long-tailed tit
- [`white_clover`](http://emitanaka.org/datascan/reference/white_clover.md)
  : A field experiment assessing the roles of drought, herbivory, and
  local climate for white clovers
